name: Pfaffenhofen an der Ilm (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the greater city arms of Pfaffenhofen an der Ilm (a yellow chevron on blue with crest).
history: The yellow-blue striped banner carries the greater city arms shifted upward.

features.role: Pfaffenhofen an der Ilm greater arms — chevron on blue
